announcements.headline: Update on Ambrose Healthcare shareholding
announcements.insight: ValiRx updates its stake in Ambrose Healthcare following earlier evaluations of Cytolytix. This governance filing reflects routine portfolio monitoring rather than a strategic shift.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM, Warrants & Directorate Change
announcements.insight: Directorate changes follow recent evaluation conclusions. Shareholders should monitor governance shifts.

announcements.headline: Conclusion of Evaluation with University of Dundee
announcements.insight: ValiRx concludes its evaluation of the asset following the June option exercise. This confirms the completion of a prior strategic step.

announcements.headline: Conclusion of Evaluation with Stingray
announcements.insight: ValiRx concludes its evaluation of an asset following the May patent grant and June option exercise. This milestone follows the earlier strategic steps taken by the company.

announcements.headline: ValiRx Exercises Option on Evaluation Asset
announcements.insight: ValiRx exercises an option on an evaluation asset following the May 2026 patent grant. This advances the commercialisation of the newly protected intellectual property.

announcements.headline: Cytolytix Patent Granted
announcements.insight: Valirx has secured a patent for Cytolytix. This intellectual property milestone may support future commercialization efforts but lacks financial detail.
